wiki_text: On 28-29 May 2026, Transnet National Ports Authority (TNPA) signed a 25-year Terminal Operator Agreement with Ukwanda LNG to develop and operate an LNG import (regasification) terminal at the Port of Ngqura in the Eastern Cape. Ukwanda LNG is a joint venture between Tamasa Energy Group and South Africa's Strategic Fuel Fund. The project is valued at approximately R22 billion (about US$1.34 billion), including a roughly R2 billion dedicated LNG berth to be built by TNPA at one of South Africa's deepest ports. It is designated a national strategic integrated project intended to support an allocation of about 3,000 MW of gas-to-power capacity in the region, with full operations targeted for 2035 and a construction period of roughly 36 months. Coverage describes the facility as an onshore regasification terminal, with most reports indicating a temporary floating unit during ramp-up plus permanent onshore infrastructure (GEM's existing project note flags a possible two-phase plan that could include an FSRU).

topic: Zululand Energy Terminal FID delayed to 2028; Eskom gas-to-power dependency
wiki_text: In early March 2026, Vopak said it had pushed the final investment decision (FID) on the Zululand Energy Terminal LNG import project at Richards Bay to the first quarter of 2028, having previously planned to decide in early 2026. Oliver Naidu, president of Vopak's South African unit, told Reuters at the African Energy Indaba in Cape Town that the company extended its pre-FEED study after a September 2025 court order halted state utility Eskom's plans for a 3,000 MW gas-fired power plant at Richards Bay, a key anchor offtaker for the terminal. The two-phase terminal (a JV of Vopak and Transnet Pipelines, selected in 2024 to build and operate it for 25 years) is estimated to cost around US$1 billion (reported by some outlets as about R18 billion). Phase 1 envisages a floating storage unit (FSU, ~135,000-174,000 m3) with onshore regasification of about 400 mmscfd; Phase 2 would replace the FSU with an onshore storage tank, raising send-out toward ~600 mmscfd.
